description:
Free discovery: score up to 25 wallets in a single call (each via the same
    transparent model as score_wallet_for_intel). Convenience for triaging a set of
    candidate counterparties at once; `requested`/`capped` disclose any truncation.

wallets.description: List of wallets (Solana base58 or Base 0x) to score in one call (hard cap 25; extras are dropped).
wallets.title: Wallets

name: score_wallets_batch

capped.description: True if the request exceeded max_per_call.
capped.title: Capped

error.description: Present only on the degraded path.
error.title: Error

max_per_call.description: Hard cap on wallets per batch call.
max_per_call.title: Max Per Call

results.description: Per-wallet score objects (same shape as score_wallet_for_intel).
results.title: Results
